# Version 4.150.0
> **Filters and faster raster drawing** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 brings Skia m150, composable filters, and faster CPU blur and canvas access.

## Breaking Changes

- **Replace remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs** — Remaining pre-v4 obsolete constructors and run-buffer methods now produce compile errors. Use GRBackendRenderTarget constructors without sampleCount and the Glyphs/Positions properties. Replace SKPaintHinting with SKFontHinting and SKFilterQuality with SKSamplingOptions; obsolete enum types remain in the implementation assembly for ABI compatibility. The two SKCanvas.DrawText overloads with SKFont but without explicit SKTextAlign remain warning-only. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **Notebook integration is no longer bundled** — The deprecated .NET Interactive / Polyglot Notebooks extension is no longer embedded in the SkiaSharp package. Applications or notebooks relying on automatic formatter registration must provide their own integration or move to a supported host. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Engine

- **Skia m150** — Updates the bundled renderer from m148 to m150 while retaining PDF support on Tizen and the existing Windows runtime floor. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146))
- **HarfBuzz 14.2.1** — Refreshes bundled text shaping with AAT, Arabic fallback, COLR v1, and glyph-extents corrections. ([#4167](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4167))

## API Surface

- **Fast paint bounds for culling** — SKPaint.GetFastBounds returns conservative bounds for use with SKCanvas.QuickReject, or false when the paint cannot compute them. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))
- **Composable filters and overdraw inspection** — SKImageFilter.CreateCrop adds rectangle and tile-mode cropping; CreateEmpty discards input to transparent black. SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw maps draw counts to a six-color palette. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227), [#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small-blur raster performance restored** — Restores the dedicated CPU blur path for small-sigma blurs of 8888 images instead of the slower shader-based path. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))
- **Apple typeface stream synchronization** — Corrects a race when opening or cloning streams from shared CoreText-backed typefaces. ([#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Cheaper surface canvas access** — SKSurface.Canvas reuses its managed wrapper instead of repeating native lookups, and reacquires a usable wrapper if the previous one was explicitly disposed. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

The collected companion changes are test-infrastructure updates; this HarfBuzzSharp block adds no consumer-facing shaping or API change.
